title: ON HATE SCALING LAWS FOR DATA-SWAMPS

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot image classification using OpenCLIP on the Chicago Face Dataset (CFD) to measure the association between faces of different racial groups and dehumanizing or criminal text labels (e.g., 'criminal', 'suspicious person', 'gorilla') via cosine similarity and softmax probabilities.
Measured intersectionally with race by comparing model misclassification rates and harmful label associations across self-identified male and female subjects from the Chicago Face Dataset.
Textual audit of dataset alt-text descriptions using the pre-trained Pysentimiento NLP model to compute a Hate Content Rate (HCR) based on the presence of hateful, targeted, and aggressive speech.
